sloka: शुद्ध आत्मन् प्रेम भावाद्द् हि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा ।भर्तारम् अनुगच्चन्ती भर्ता हि मम दैवतम् ॥२-२९-१६॥
transliteration: śuddha ātman prema bhāvādd hi bhaviṣyāmi vikalmaṣā ।bhartāram anugaccantī bhartā hi mama daivatam ॥2-29-16॥

translations.english: O my purehearted one by following my husband with love I shall become sinless, because my husband is my god.
